entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: A sage, co-founder and leader of the College of Lat-Nam and a founder of the Union of the Third Path.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife, a skilled mage who died unsummoning three dragon engines.

entities.name: College of Lat-Nam
entities.description: A school of magic on an island near Terisiare co-founded by Drafna.

entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: Group Drafna and Hurkyl helped found.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Brothers' War took place.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war on Dominaria between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City on Terisiare where the Third Path was based.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: The destruction of Terisia City, in which Hurkyl died.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Drafna's rival, who smuggled the Golgothian Sylex out with Loran.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Character who helped Feldon smuggle the Sylex and who saw Urza in Drafna.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact smuggled out of Terisia City.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Likely destroyer of the College of Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer whom Drafna's artifact curiosity recalled to Loran.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: Hidden school of magic founded by Drafna and other surviving Third Path members; it later became the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy that inherited the Third Path's works.

events.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl arrive in Terisia City from the College of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: both Hurkyl and Drafna were fully shaved bald

events.summary: Drafna is present for the Fall of Terisia City, where Hurkyl dies unsummoning three dragon engines.
events.quote: his wife Hurkyl died after unsummoning three dragon engines

events.summary: A grieving Drafna takes charge of the defenses and has artifacts shuttled out through secret tunnels.
events.quote: A grieving Drafna took charge of the defenses

events.summary: Feldon, aided by Loran, secretly smuggles the Golgothian Sylex out another way.
events.quote: Feldon was aided by Loran in secretly smuggling the Golgothian Sylex out

events.summary: Drafna survives and returns to the College of Lat-Nam, which is then destroyed, likely by Mishra.
events.quote: the college too was destroyed, likely by Mishra

events.summary: Drafna and other surviving Third Path members found the hidden City of Shadows.
events.quote: he founded yet another school of magic

relations.quote: co-founder and leader of the College of Lat-Nam
